info.title: ClimateAdapt-Comfort Decision-Support API
info.description: Research decision-support API for passive building design across Indian climate zones. Serves verified simulation results, CPWD DSR cost ranges, Comfort Fit Scores, and SHAP explainability. Zero live EnergyPlus runs; all numbers trace to audited repository artifacts.

get.description: Returns the 5 simulated reference climate stations with confidence tiers and applicability.

Matches any input location query or coordinates to the nearest of the 5 simulated cities.
Returns strong warning if distance exceeds the configurable threshold (default 300 km).
Returns monthly climate summary and current/+1.5°C/+3.0°C morphed scenarios.
Returns the empirical city comfort norms, reference building performance, and DB II preferences.
Returns the bilingual occupant comfort questionnaire schema.

post.description:
Evaluates user comfort profile against local typical baseline and 3 candidate packages.
Returns 0-100 Comfort Fit Scores, comfort gain points, and dual-judge disagreement.

get.description:
Returns the three curated design packages (Budget, Balanced, Best-Comfort)
with BOM, cost range, carbon, and 12-month before/after temperature profiles.

parameters.name: city

schema.description: Reference city (e.g. Jodhpur, Mumbai, New_Delhi, Bengaluru, Shimla)
schema.title: City

parameters.description: Reference city (e.g. Jodhpur, Mumbai, New_Delhi, Bengaluru, Shimla)

get.description:
Returns the 100 Pareto-optimal designs for a given city and building typology,
with flexible multi-objective range filters and pagination.

parameters.name: verified_only

schema.description: Filter for EnergyPlus physically verified designs only
schema.title: Verified Only

get.description:
Returns SHAP feature drivers and plain-language explanation templates (EN/HI)
for a specific Pareto design.

Returns full research scorecard (S1-S4), comfort model leaderboard with 95% bootstrap CIs,
surrogate accuracy matrices per typology, and chronological phase evidence links.

post.description:
Generates and downloads a builder-ready passive design specification PDF.
Contains BOM, 12-month temperature chart image, design variables, cost statement, and checksum footer.
